# Free LLM APIs that start with a free credit

AI APIs that give a one-time free credit or token balance at signup, which runs out instead of renewing — a live slice of a verified dataset.

[← All collections](README.md) · [Interactive explorer ↗](https://freellmapihub.com/) · [Main list](../README.md)

Providers whose free access is a **one-time credit** (`free_type: trial-credit`): it is spent, not renewed. Renewing allowances are in their own collection. Some credits expire, with windows from 30 days to a year in the dataset, and a provider that has not been re-verified is left out.

**33 of 64 tracked providers** match.
